messages:
rachel.docs: Quick announcement: we're tightening SDK config parsing next week. Unknown top-level keys will be rejected and an explicit `routes` block will be required. This affects self-hosted configs. Migration doc: https://redwood.inference/internal/docs/config-schema-tightening :eyes:

ben.sdk: Timeline? Will SDKs include shims/warnings?

rachel.docs: Beta opt-in starts 2026-03-25, hard enforcement 2026-04-01. SDKs will ship a 2-release compatibility shim (warning -> error).

ajay.eng: Which SDKs get the shim initially? Node/Python versions?

rachel.docs: Node >=4.0.0 and Python >=3.2.0 include the shim. Go and Rust teams will do warning-only for one release then enforce.

lisa.product: Can Dedicated/Private customers request a delay?

rachel.docs: Yes. Use env var `REDWOOD_CONFIG_STRICT=false` to opt-out during the short exception window (requests handled until 2026-04-15). Route exceptions to customers@redwood.com with subject: "Config strictness exception".

ben.sdk: Added migration snippet to guide?

rachel.docs: Added. Example in guide:

```
# old 
model: "redwood-llm-v1"
model_override: { sequence_length: 4096 }

# new 
routes: [
  { name: "default", model: "redwood-llm-v1", model_overrides: { sequence_length: 4096 } }
]
```

ajay.eng: I'll audit infra repos for stray top-level keys and post results by EOD.

rachel.docs: Thanks  we'll also publish a `rake config:lint` helper in the docs repo.

deploy-bot: published internal doc: /internal/docs/config-schema-tightening  public-facing page scheduled for 2026-03-23 :rocket:

lisa.product: I'll prepare the customer KB and short notice template for Support.

rachel.docs: Great, tagging Growth/Support in the ops thread. :thumbsup:

ben.sdk: Hosted API fallback window?

rachel.docs: Hosted API accepts old configs read-only until 2026-05-01; warnings start 2026-03-25 and new writes may error after 2026-04-01 unless `REDWOOD_CONFIG_STRICT=false` is set.

ajay.eng: Copy that. I'll share a quick infra checklist.

rachel.docs: Thanks everyone.
